supersedes.reason: The frozen 70-row file is an exhaustive orientation registry, not a requirement to execute every generated orientation as a QM target.

rules.registry: All 70 generated orientations remain registered and receive a prospective signed disposition before fitting.
rules.applicable: Retain chemically applicable polar interactions selected for the charge-fit target set; a converged HF/6-31G(d) distance optimization and retained input/output are mandatory.
rules.weak: Use only for a converged evaluated interaction judged weak; retained HF/6-31G(d) input/output are mandatory and the interaction is not silently dropped.
rules.unfavourable: Use only for a converged evaluated interaction with an unfavourable QM interaction; retained HF/6-31G(d) input/output are mandatory and it is excluded from fitting with an explicit rationale.
rules.excluded: May be assigned before QM only for a source-supported nonpolar or unselected target, a steric clash, or unavoidable competing interaction. A retained visual or chemical review artifact is mandatory; QM artifacts must be absent.
rules.failed_attempts: All failed attempts are retained. A failed QM calculation cannot complete an applicable, weak, or unfavourable row and cannot enter the target set.
rules.selection: For multiple orientations at one non-hydrogen atom, retain orientations that maximize the intended atom interaction and minimize competing parent-molecule interactions, after visual steric review.
